newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Bank of NZ 9 month profit unchanged at NZ$230 mln.
newsitem.headline: Bank of NZ 9 month profit unchanged at NZ$230 mln.

text.p: National Australia Bank's Bank of New Zealand Ltd on Tuesday reported a NZ$230 million net profit after tax and extraordinary items for the nine months to June 30, unchanged from the same year ago period.
The net profit as an annualised percentage of total assets was 1.36 percent, down from 1.59 percent in the nine months to June 30, 1995.
Total assets as at June 30 were NZ$23.3 billion, up 15.25 percent from $20.2 billion a year ago.
Tier one capital adequacy comprised 6.76 percent of its risk weighted exposures, up from 6.66 percent a year ago.
The group's capital comprised 11.39 percent of its risk weighted exposures, up from 11.07 percent.
Total impaired assets were worth NZ$258 million, down from $398 million.
Impaired assets represented 1.11 percent of total assets, down from 1.97 percent.
Total specific provisions were $133 million, down from $244 million. They comprised 48.01 percent of total impaired assets, down from 58.37 percent.
